transcript:
Customer: Hi, I’m calling because I was charged twice this month for my Pro plan subscription, and I’m really confused about that.

Agent: Hi there! I’m sorry to hear about that. Let’s take a look at your account and see what happened with those charges. Can I have your email address associated with the account, please?

Customer: Sure, it’s jane.doe@example.com. 

Agent: Thank you, Jane. I’ll pull up your account now... Alright, I see the double charge. One seems to be from our regular billing cycle, and the other is due to an extra feature you activated last month. 

Customer: I didn’t activate any extra features! I only use the standard features included in the Pro plan.

Agent: I understand your frustration. It looks like there was an unintentional upgrade applied. Let’s get that rectified right away. I can refund the extra charge for you.

Customer: That would be great. But can you also make sure it doesn’t happen again?

Agent: Absolutely, I’ll make a note on your account to ensure that only the Pro plan features are applied moving forward. You’ll receive the refund within 3-5 business days.

Customer: Thank you. I appreciate that! One more question—are there any new features coming for the Pro plan soon?

Agent: Great question! We’re actually rolling out a new analytics dashboard next month for Pro plan users. It’ll help you track your usage more effectively.

Customer: That sounds useful! I might need to look into those features more. How do I access updates?

Agent: We send out monthly newsletters to all our subscribers, and you can also check our blog for updates. If you'd like, I can add you to the priority notification list.

Customer: Yes, please do that. I’d like to stay informed about any updates.

Agent: Done! You’ll get the updates directly in your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

Customer: No, that’s all. Thank you for your help!

Agent: You’re welcome, Jane! I’m glad I could assist you today. If you need anything else, don’t hesitate to reach out. Have a great day!

Customer: You too! Bye. 

Agent: Goodbye!
